examples.en: I had to look up the error code — it was not in our runbook.
examples.zh: 我得查一下这个错误码，我们手册里没写。

situation.en: Look it up in the internal wiki first; if it's not there, ask in the channel.
situation.zh: 新同事问你一个概念，你让他先查文档。

examples.en: Could you look after the deployment while I am on leave?
examples.zh: 我休假的时候你能帮我照看发布吗？

situation.en: I'll look after your services while you're away.
situation.zh: 同事要休长假，你说他的服务你来看着。

examples.en: Looking back, the rewrite should have started a year earlier.
examples.zh: 现在回想，这个重写应该早一年开始的。

situation.en: Looking back, skipping the design review was our biggest mistake.
situation.zh: 面试讲教训时，你用回想的口吻开头。

examples.en: Looking ahead, the next big cost is the data platform renewal.
examples.zh: 往前看，下一笔大开销是数据平台的续约。

situation.en: Looking ahead to next quarter, we have two launches and a migration.
situation.zh: 季度规划一开始你展望接下来的事。

examples.en: Can you pick out the three riskiest items from this list?
examples.zh: 你能从这个清单里挑出风险最高的三项吗？

situation.en: Pick out two examples you're proud of and we'll polish them for the interview.
situation.zh: 你指导同事故后面试，让他挑两个例子。

examples.en: He backed down once the data showed his approach was slower.
examples.zh: 数据表明他的方案更慢之后，他就让步了。

situation.en: I won't back down on the testing requirement.
situation.zh: 评审有分歧时你表明哪些事不能让步。

examples.en: We gave in and added the export button the customer kept asking for.
examples.zh: 我们最后还是妥协了，加上了客户一直要的导出按钮。

situation.en: Don't give in on security reviews, whatever the deadline pressure.
situation.zh: 你提醒同事有些底线不能因为赶工让掉。

examples.en: She stood up for the junior engineer when the client blamed him unfairly.
examples.zh: 客户不公正地责怪那个新人时，她站出来维护了他。

situation.en: I'll stand up for the team's estimate in the planning meeting.
situation.zh: 你跟团队保证，会上你会维护大家的估时。

entries.zh: 为（某人、原则）挺身而出、维护

examples.en: The support team stands by during every launch, just in case.
examples.zh: 每次上线支持团队都在旁待命，以防万一。

entries.note: stand by 还有“支持、信守”的意思：stand by my decision 支持我的决定。

situation.en: Stand by — the build is almost done, I'll ping you.
situation.zh: 你在频道里让大家稍等、保持待命。

entries.zh: 待命、在旁等候；支持（决定）

examples.en: Do not hold back in the retro — say what actually went wrong.
examples.zh: 复盘的时候别藏着掖着，把真问题说出来。

situation.en: Something is holding back the rollout, and it's not technical.
situation.zh: 你指出发布推进受阻，但不是技术原因。

entries.zh: 克制、有所保留；阻碍（进展）

examples.en: The deal fell through at the last minute over the payment terms.
examples.zh: 这笔交易在最后一刻因为付款条款黄了。

situation.en: The migration fell through twice, so we changed the approach.
situation.zh: 你向经理汇报：计划两次落空了。

examples.en: Under deadline pressure, the review process fell apart completely.
examples.zh: 一赶工期，评审流程就彻底散架了。

situation.en: Without tests, this codebase will fall apart within a year.
situation.zh: 你警告说没有测试代码库很快会失控。

entries.zh: 散架、崩溃（系统、计划、情绪）

examples.en: We fell behind on the roadmap after two people resigned.
examples.zh: 两个人离职后，我们的路线图进度落下了。

situation.en: We're falling behind on the docs — can we borrow an hour on Friday?
situation.zh: 站会上你报告文档进度落后了。

examples.en: Nobody thought we could migrate in a weekend, but we pulled it off.
examples.zh: 没人觉得我们能在一个周末迁完，但我们做成了。

situation.en: If we pull this off, it'll be the smoothest launch we've had.
situation.zh: 上线前夜你给团队打气。

examples.en: The team pulled through the outage with no data loss.
examples.zh: 团队挺过了这次故障，数据一点没丢。

situation.en: It was a brutal quarter, but we pulled through.
situation.zh: 季度末回顾时你说大家一起挺过来了。

examples.en: Traffic slows down noticeably after the evening peak.
examples.zh: 晚高峰一过，流量明显降下来。

situation.en: Let's slow down and get the design right before writing code.
situation.zh: 你建议团队别赶，先把设计做好。

examples.en: A checklist would speed up the review process a lot.
examples.zh: 有个清单能让评审流程快不少。

situation.en: Hiring one more reviewer would speed things up.
situation.zh: 你提议加一个评审人来提速。

examples.en: The new dashboard caught on quickly — now every team uses it.
examples.zh: 新的仪表盘很快流行起来，现在每个团队都在用。

situation.en: It took a while, but pairing sessions finally caught on.
situation.zh: 你介绍团队文化时说结对编程慢慢被大家接受了。

examples.en: How is the migration coming along?
examples.zh: 迁移进展得怎么样了？

situation.en: The prototype is coming along nicely — demo on Friday.
situation.zh: 经理问项目怎么样，你说进展不错。

entries.zh: 进展、进行（问进展的常用句）

examples.en: I am working on a fix for the flaky test right now.
examples.zh: 我正在修那个不稳定的测试。

situation.en: I'm working on it — expect an update by three.
situation.zh: 同事催你，你说正在弄、三点前有消息。

examples.en: We used to hang out after work every Friday at the place downstairs.
examples.zh: 以前我们每周五下班都去楼下那家店聚。

situation.en: A few of us are hanging out after the meetup — join us?
situation.zh: 活动结束后你邀请同事一起坐坐。

examples.en: I bumped into our old CTO at the conference last week.
examples.zh: 上周开会时我偶遇了我们以前的 CTO。

situation.en: I bumped into Sarah — she says hi, by the way.
situation.zh: 你跟同事转述偶遇共同朋友的事。

examples.en: If you are stuck, reach out to the platform team — they are happy to help.
examples.zh: 卡住了就联系平台组，他们乐意帮忙。

situation.en: I'll reach out to the design team about the empty states.
situation.zh: 你说你去联系设计组确认空状态。

examples.en: We are getting by with one part-time designer for now.
examples.zh: 我们现在靠一个兼职设计师凑合着。

situation.en: How are you getting by with such a small team?
situation.zh: 面试官问你们人这么少怎么运转的。

examples.en: He got away with skipping the tests because nobody reviewed his code.
examples.zh: 没人评审他的代码，他跳过测试也没被发现。

situation.en: You can't get away with manual deploys at our scale anymore.
situation.zh: 你指出在现在的规模下手动发布混不过去了。

entries.zh: 做了（坏事）而没被惩罚、蒙混过关

examples.en: Working late on Friday was my way of making up for the slow start on Monday.
examples.zh: 周五加班是我在补周一的慢启动。

situation.en: I'll make up for the missed review tomorrow morning.
situation.zh: 你向同事保证明天补上漏掉的评审。

examples.en: I mixed up the staging and production URLs in the config.
examples.zh: 我把预发和生产的地址在配置里搞混了。

situation.en: Sorry, I mixed up the two tickets — yours is the second one.
situation.zh: 你向同事道歉把两个工单弄混了。

entries.zh: 搞混、弄错（两个相似的东西）

examples.en: The report leaves out the failed experiments, which makes it look better than it was.
examples.zh: 报告把失败的实验都省了，所以显得比实际好看。

situation.en: Don't leave out the rollback plan from the doc.
situation.zh: 你提醒同事文档里别漏了回滚方案。

examples.en: We could settle for the simpler design and revisit it next year.
examples.zh: 我们可以将就用这个更简单的设计，明年再回头看。

situation.en: I won't settle for a dashboard nobody checks.
situation.zh: 你表明你不想做一个没人看的仪表盘糊弄过去。

entries.zh: 将就、勉强接受（不如预期的）

examples.en: The final product lived up to the demo's promise.
examples.zh: 最终产品达到了演示时承诺的效果。

entries.note: 反义是 let down（batch 2 已收）或 fall short of 没达到。

situation.en: We need the launch to live up to the marketing claims.
situation.zh: 你在会上提醒上线效果得对得起宣传。

examples.en: The numbers do not add up — revenue minus costs is not what the sheet says.
examples.zh: 数字对不上，收入减成本不等于表里写的。

situation.en: Something doesn't add up in this timeline.
situation.zh: 你质疑排期里有讲不通的地方。

examples.en: After the incident, trust in the release process turned around completely.
examples.zh: 那次故障之后，大家对发布流程的信任完全好转了。

situation.en: We turned around the onboarding in one quarter.
situation.zh: 你介绍自己把入职流程扭转过来的成绩。

entries.zh: （局面）好转、扭转； turnaround 也是周转时间

examples.en: The on-call phone's battery wears out after a year of nightly charging.
examples.zh: 每晚充电一年后，值班手机的电池就不行了。

situation.en: I'm worn out after three launches in a month.
situation.zh: 你跟同事说一个月发了三次版，人都累瘫了。

examples.en: The effect of the caffeine wears off around three in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 咖啡因的效果大概在下午三点就消退了。

situation.en: The novelty will wear off — people always go back to old habits.
situation.zh: 你评价一个新工具：新鲜劲会过去的。

examples.en: Let me zero in on the one query that eats half the budget.
examples.zh: 我先盯住那一条吃掉一半预算的查询细看。

situation.en: The profiling zeroed in on serialization as the hot spot.
situation.zh: 你在复盘里说分析定位到了热点。

entries.zh: 锁定、聚焦到（某个具体点）

examples.en: The company laid off forty people when the contract ended.
examples.zh: 合同结束后，公司裁了四十个人。

situation.en: There are rumors of layoffs, but nothing is confirmed.
situation.zh: 同事问起裁员传闻，你说还没证实。

examples.en: The visa approval is holding up the whole relocation plan.
examples.zh: 签证审批卡住了整个搬迁计划。

entries.note: hold up 还有“举起”和名词 holdup（延误；抢劫），工作语境里基本都是“被耽搁”。

situation.en: What's holding up the release?
situation.zh: 你在站会上问发布被什么卡住了。

examples.en: She stepped down as tech lead to focus on architecture work.
examples.zh: 她卸任了技术负责人，专心做架构。

situation.en: Our manager is stepping down next month.
situation.zh: 你向团队同步管理层变动。

examples.en: The email about the outage set off a long thread of complaints.
examples.zh: 那封故障通知邮件引发了一长串抱怨。

entries.note: set off 还有“出发”：set off at dawn 一早出发。靠语境区分。

situation.en: That config change set off a chain of failures.
situation.zh: 复盘时你说一个配置改动引发了连锁故障。

examples.en: New joiners warm up with small tickets in their first two weeks.
examples.zh: 新人前两周先拿小工单热身。

situation.en: Let me warm up with the easy reviews first.
situation.zh: 早上开始工作前你随口说一句。
